increment: B (worker-local reuse) — A was engagement-NONE by design
statement: Increment B engages the unchanged public path: RunBatch rows call RunAccessibility -> AddNetwork/AddOrigins/AddDestinations exactly as before; inside those calls an admitted .geojson input is now served from a worker-local prepared table after its exact bytes are re-read and re-hashed. No dispatch change, no second entrypoint, no benchmark-only constructor, no public-API reduction (BuildAccessPoints gained a private, default-None `_prepared_req` kwarg used only by the Add* wrappers).

admission_and_gating.formats: .geojson ONLY in this increment (.geojson-first per contract admission_domain and designs/02); feather/parquet rows are requests==0 and run the produced path (fixture-pinned)
admission_and_gating.kill_switch: UNA_PREPARED=0 disables admission entirely (fixture-pinned: zero requests, produced results unchanged) — the paired-control lever for later measured runs
admission_and_gating.scope_guards: empty layers refused at publish (produced path handles them); a produced failure never publishes; network without a stage identity -> snap layers unadmitted (produced path)
admission_and_gating.identity: closure over snapshot sha256 + producer-read params + profile + env (mirrors una:topology:v1 / una:snap:v1 field-for-field); snap chains parent network stage; path/mtime never consulted (PP03 rewrites bytes under a preserved mtime and must miss)

what_serving_changes_for_a_row.skipped_on_hit: pyogrio/arrow decode AND the snap sindex/line_locate_point/interpolate work
what_serving_changes_for_a_row.still_runs_on_hit: the per-row file read + sha256 (identity law), geometry validation via the SAME helpers the produced path calls (fail-closed on corrupted payloads, fixture-pinned with produced-identical error text), CRS-vs-network validation, content-derived log replay in produced order
what_serving_changes_for_a_row.state_handed_to_consumers: fresh copies of every array/GeoSeries/GeoDataFrame the produced path would have freshly built; the lease payload is never handed out (publish-side and restore-side copies both fixture-pinned)
what_serving_changes_for_a_row.downstream_key_completeness: prepared publish records the composed una:topology:v1 / una:snap:v1 identity on the object in every path, so engine o_access keys (which chain origins/destinations._stage_key) stay complete regardless of serving path

interaction_with_stage_cache.coexistence: fixture-pinned: prepared serves first (short-circuit), stage-cache counters do not move on prepared-served rows, stage identities identical across serving paths
interaction_with_stage_cache.stage_conformance_suites: tests/cache runs with UNA_PREPARED=0 via tests/cache/conftest.py because those suites certify STAGE-cache served-hit observables; prepared semantics live in the preparation suite. Misuse risk: none — prepared-off is the exact pre-B code path

measured_public_claim_duty: no performance claim is filed with this increment; the 10x PUBLIC boundary measurement happens at the P05 gate under the frozen policy with paired controls (kill switch provides the prepared-off arm)
next: increment C (run-wide single-flight per immutable dependency identity, PP05-PP09, budget/eviction under live leases)
